content: Zustand is the 2026 default for client UI state (sidebar selection, active tab, panel state) - ~1-3KB, no provider, hook-based. Pair with TanStack Query for server-state (fetching/saving config JSON via the local REST API, caching, invalidation). Redux Toolkit is overkill for a single-developer local tool. Jotai is a reasonable alternative if per-field atomic reactivity becomes a performance need on very large nested config forms.
